text:
Situation: Haloperidol lactate 5 mg/mL 1 mL vials are critically low at Corvale East with 5.3 days on hand. Corvale General holds 17.9 days and Corvale Lakeside holds 15.7 days. The product is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show haloperidol lactate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. The product label for NDC 55154955305 names Fresenius Kabi USA as the manufacturing plant. Alternate manufacturers Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., BluePoint Laboratories, and Caplin Steriles Limited are not on the shortage list, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Our position: Internal redistribution is the fastest and most reliable path to stabilize Corvale East. Purchasing from alternate sources adds uncertainty because manufacturing sites cannot be verified.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 30 vials of 5 mg/mL 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Transfer 3 vials of 5 mg/mL 1 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
3. Evaluate purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. if transfers are insufficient — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories if transfers are insufficient — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited if transfers are insufficient — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical substitutions or dosing changes; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
